label: Own funds
definition: Funds of the operator, including tariffs, under the polluter-pays or user-pays principle.

label: National-federal
definition: Funds from the national or federal budget.

label: Loan
definition: A loan from a public or private lender.

label: Private funds
definition: Private funding other than a loan.

label: Not identified
definition: The source of this part of the cost is not yet identified.
